svg.title: quant_error at a glance
svg.desc: 6 output files with numbers only; 56 tests in 6 files; the rehearsal at the dry-run-2 shape ran in 87.8 s and wrote 213 KB.
svg.text: Where does quantization error come from?
One offline command: quantized GGUFs against their bf16 reference on G5’s held-out text, per tensor, layer, router and slice
numbers only: no text, no token ids
in 6 test files, one end to end
